ingredients.name: tomatoes, or one 14-ounce can of chopped tomatoes

steps.instruction: Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the slow cooker.
Put 1 3/4 pounds of chuck steak in the slow cooker.
Set the slow cooker to high.
Cut 1/4 head of cauliflower into pieces you like.
Add the cauliflower to the slow cooker.
Chop or slice 1/3 of the fennel bulb.
Add the fennel to the slow cooker.
Crush 7 ounces of tomatoes and add them.
steps.spoken: Crush 7 ounces of tomatoes and add them, or add one 14-ounce can of chopped tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Add the rest of the 3 tablespoons of olive oil.
Let it cook for at least 6 hours.
Serve with the rest of the fennel, chopped or sliced.
